scope: Host-session pilot of `cpos_launch --config host`: historical TDG FY2024 credit snapshot as of 2024-09-30, CP-0 -> CP-1 -> CP-1A, same context, issuer folder and modules as the paid sol-medium run runs/cpos-launch-live-002. The answering host was the Claude Code session that built the launcher option, working from the pinned files. Not independent review, not provider proof, not current underwriting.

execution.host_usage: Not measured; the host session's own model usage is outside the CP-OS budget.
execution.protocol: Each launch ran CP-OS until a module request had no answer (exit 3), printed the request, answer path, pinned sources and upstream handoffs; the host wrote the answer and relaunched the same command.

attempt_1.result: All three modules accepted on the first CP-OS attempt; report published with 4 of 4 selected sections populated.
defects_found_after_acceptance: CP-1 omitted the covenant terms the 10-K describes: no maintenance covenants except a springing revolver test of 7.50x net debt to EBITDA As Defined above 40% usage (page 62), incremental tests of 7.25x net and 5.00x secured net (pages 61-62), and management's statement that covenant EBITDA is defined as EBITDA As Defined (page 70).
CP-0 did not flag that the 10-K was signed on November 7, 2024, after the as-of date, while the context cutoff is blank.
CP-0 called the PDF a reproduction of the whole 10-K; only the audit opinion, statements and contents page were checked.
attempt_1.how_found: Comparison with the retained live-002 answers, then checked against the 10-K pages. The automated CP-OS checker cannot find omissions of this kind.

attempt_2.result: Targeted repair of the three defects in a new run folder; attempt 1 is retained unchanged. All three modules accepted on the first CP-OS attempt; report published with 4 of 4 selected sections populated.
attempt_2.repair_also_logged: The 10-K describes the revolver test two ways: net debt to EBITDA As Defined (page 62) and secured indebtedness to Consolidated EBITDA (page 70). Logged as a conflict, not reconciled.

per_run: verify_delivery passes; completion records host-session for every module, zero cap, no live/ folder
consumption anchors: CP-0 hash in CP-1 and CP-1A, CP-1 hash in CP-1A
79 reported CP-1 rows, 220 cells, each found after its printed label on the cited 10-K page (pages 71, 120-123, 144-145)
18 calculated metric cells recomputed with Fraction from those source rows and the page 52 total-debt row; pro forma figures from the page 56 footnote
relaunch publishes the same report path, sends nothing and writes no file
checks.adversarial: The checker refused a changed figure (7,941), swapped balance-sheet years and a 5.97x ratio.

comparison_with_live_002.same: Every reported statement figure checked, e.g. net sales 7,940, cash 6,261, carrying total debt 24,880, EBITDA As Defined 4,173, coverage 3.24x.
comparison_with_live_002.basis_difference: Live leverage uses gross principal 25,068 (6.01x; net 4.51x); host uses the 10-K's carrying total debt 24,880 (5.96x; net 4.46x). Live also shows the carrying net debt of 18,619. Both bases are labelled; neither is covenant leverage.
only_live_on_first_pass: springing revolver covenant and compliance statement (page 62)
only_host: dividend-equivalent conflict: 132 in the 10-K (page 170) against 131 in the FY2025 first-quarter 10-Q (page 44)
comparison_with_live_002.size: Live answers 22-45 KB per module from 29 calls at USD 0.93; host answers 17-27 KB.

limits: One issuer, one date, three modules; not the full credit_snapshot preset.
The host also wrote the checks and the comparison, so this is not an independent review.
The report is the launcher's report only; no HTML Model, charts or calculation JSON.
Narrative and governance judgments were compared with the live answer, not with an answer key.
next: For an agent swarm: one agent per run folder answers through this protocol, and a second agent or model reviews each accepted handoff against the sources before the run is used; a confirmed defect is repaired in a new run folder.
